title: Build a conversational turn that fits
description: Choose a workload and memory contract, then tune history, evidence, and output. The model exposes what will be admitted, dropped, billed, and delivered before the request starts.

workloads.label: Customer support assistant
workloads.detail: Policy-heavy answers with account-safe retrieval and concise resolution steps.

workloads.label: Coding copilot
workloads.detail: Longer turns, repository evidence, structured tool results, and larger generated patches.

workloads.label: Regulated guidance assistant
workloads.detail: Strict instructions, narrow evidence, audit metadata, and bounded explanatory output.
